name: Drift & Quality Watch
tagline: Catch the agent that degraded silently.
summary: Persona and vector drift detection, 9-dimension quality scoring trends, and anomaly detection on agent behavior. Sold to teams whose agents have already gone quiet-wrong in production — which is all of them, eventually.
description: Agents do not usually fail loudly. They drift. Persona slips, retrieval vectors wander, tool use gets sloppy, cost creeps, and the operator notices weeks later. Drift & Quality Watch is the watch on that slope: persona/vector drift, a nine-dimension quality trend, and anomaly flags on behavior that left the baseline. It is not a one-shot eval. It is a production watch.
buyer: A team with agents in production that have, or will, degrade without a page. Especially anyone who has already had a silent quality incident.

features.name: Persona drift
features.detail: Detect when the agent's voice, policy stance, or role adherence leaves its enrolled baseline.

features.name: Vector drift
features.detail: Watch embedding/retrieval drift so the agent is not answering from the wrong neighborhood.

features.name: 9-dimension quality scoring
features.detail: Trend, not a trophy score. See quality_dimensions.

features.name: Anomaly detection
features.detail: Behavior that left the agent's own baseline — tool mix, latency, refusal rate, spend.

features.name: Degradation alerts
features.detail: Page when a dimension or drift metric crosses a watch threshold, not after a customer complaint.

readiness.next_action: Sell to any account that has had a silent quality incident. Convert from AUD-01 drift reports.
